trackers.monetization_model: Liftoff is a mobile advertising company; through Liftoff Monetize, the network behind Vungle's SDK, it fills ad space in apps for advertisers and shares data with partners deciding whether to bid. It says it doesn't sell personal information in personally identifiable form.

consequences.text: FinePrint finds Vungle by the code names its SDK used up to version 6 (com.vungle.warren). Version 7, out since August 2023, uses com.vungle.ads, so FinePrint doesn't find an app that has only the newer SDK.
consequences.wording: According to Vungle's SDK documentation (updated 2024-09-17, 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30).

confidence_note.text: Vungle's Google Play tables disagree. Its SDK settings pages (for SDK 6, updated 2024-09-17, and for the current SDK, 2026-09-20) list device identifiers, diagnostics and ad interactions, all shared, but no location; its Liftoff Monetize questionnaire (updated 2025-07-23) lists approximate location, collected and shared, but not device identifiers. This record follows both.
